name: COLLINS, Dr Jessica

headline.note: The documented paid role is at the nonprofit Lowy Institute, which is excluded from the public/private headline. Study, unpaid family care, party campaigning and elected office are also excluded. The available sources do not establish any countable public- or private-sector full-time spell; missing evidence is not zero.

career_spells.evidence_note: Current first-party and former-employer biographies identify undergraduate anthropology study at the University of Sydney. Dates, load and concurrent employment are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Study is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: Collins' current biography identifies an honours year at QUT; the Lowy biography says the project studied Samoan communities in Australia. Dates, scholarship terms, load and concurrent employment are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Study is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: Her current and Lowy biographies identify the PhD subject. A journal author biography says Jessica Nancy Bird completed the QUT PhD between 2010 and 2013. A scholarship is mentioned but its funding, work obligations and any concurrent paid employment are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Study is excluded; a scholarship does not by itself establish employment.

career_spells.role: Stay-at-home parent; academic publishing and master's study during the period
career_spells.evidence_note: Collins' current biography states that she spent seven years as a stay-at-home mother, published four academic papers and completed a Master of Global Development with Distinction. Calendar endpoints, any paid publishing or research contracts, and the master's institution and study dates are not supplied; the relative duration is not converted into invented dates.
career_spells.counting_note: Unpaid family care and study are excluded under the codebook; publications do not establish paid employment.

career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen official extract records Lowy service within 2021–2025. Collins' current biography gives a November 2021 start and July 2024 promotion; the Lowy profile corroborates the research-fellow role. Exact days, hours, leave and any preceding employment are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: The Lowy Institute is an independent nonprofit think tank; nonprofit employment is excluded from the public/private headline under the codebook.

career_spells.role: Project Director, Australia-Papua New Guinea Network; Research Fellow
career_spells.evidence_note: Collins' current biography dates her promotion to July 2024 and resignation before the election to March 2025. The Lowy profile corroborates both titles. Exact transition and cessation days, hours, leave and campaign overlap are unresolved; the director title is not treated as proof of full-time work.
career_spells.counting_note: Nonprofit employment is excluded from the public/private headline.

career_spells.employer: Liberal Party of Australia — NSW Division
career_spells.evidence_note: Contemporaneous reporting records Collins winning the second Coalition Senate-ticket position on 25 May 2024. Her biography records Lowy resignation in March 2025 and the frozen roster records Senate service from 1 July 2025. Campaign pay, hours, exact active-work period and overlap with Lowy are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Party and campaign activity is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen roster and Collins' current biography establish Senate service from 1 July 2025. Committee offices are nested within elected service.
career_spells.counting_note: Elected office is excluded under the codebook.

research_notes: The current first-party biography materially improves the frozen year-only Lowy record with month-level start, promotion and resignation dates.
Senior research and director titles are not treated as proof of substantive full-time status.
Government grants or policy influence do not make an independently controlled nonprofit a public-sector employer.
Seven years of family care are preserved as unpaid work without back-calculating calendar endpoints.
open_questions: What were the exact undergraduate, honours, master's and PhD dates, loads, scholarship conditions and overlaps with paid work?
Did Collins hold any paid employment before November 2021, including research, teaching or paid publication work?
What were the exact Lowy appointment dates, hours, leave and campaign arrangements?
What were the campaign's paid status, hours and exact active-work dates between preselection and Senate commencement?
